title: Ignoring Thread Interruption / Cancellation Tokens
pattern: A worker thread or background task executing an infinite loop or blocking operation without querying cooperative cancellation or shutdown state.
why_bad: It prevents clean service shutdowns. When the system attempts to redeploy or terminate, these threads hang, refusing to release resources or flush logs, forcing the OS to issue a violent SIGKILL that risks data corruption [24:208].
detection: Spawned tasks/threads containing infinite loop constructs that lack parameter dependencies on atomic cancellation flags, select/abort blocks, or cancellation futures [24:208].
fix: Inject a cooperative cancellation mechanism (atomic boolean shutdown flag or async select loop) into the loop header [24:208].
